description: Dedicate a model you created to the commons under CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0. It then appears in every user's listing with the license shown, and the dedication is IRREVOCABLE — it cannot be changed or deleted afterwards, which is what makes it safe for others to build on. CC0-1.0 is the cleanest choice for a model: attribution terms are hard to honor for a net someone folds into a larger one.
name: sim_license_model
